library.tip_1: Engage your hearing: listen to audio while reading — this activates the auditory cortex.
library.tip_2: Don't cram isolated words: memorize them in the context of phrases. The brain loves contextual links!
library.tip_3: Spaced repetition: review difficult words in 1 day, then in 3 and 7 days.
library.tip_4: Lingo tip: Read sentences with new words out loud to train articulation.
library.tip_5: Uncover roots: many languages have similar Latin or common roots. Look for analogies to remember better!
library.tip_6: Active reading method: don't be afraid of new words! Your goal is to mark them as 'learning' and keep reading.
library.tip_7: Short sessions rule: 15 minutes of engaging reading every day is more effective than 2 hours once a week.
library.tip_8: Grasp the meaning: you don't have to translate every single word. Learn to guess from the context!
library.hero_title: What story will you learn today?
library.hero_subtitle: Interactive reading method: tap on any unfamiliar words, download translations and listen to audio!

ignore_lists.header_desc: Automatically filters out global brands, consoles, and world cities. Real English vocabulary words (apple, cloud, drop, boss, cool) are protected and never ignored when learning English.

ignore_lists.category_anglicisms_desc: English loanwords in foreign texts. Automatically disabled when studying English.
ignore_lists.protection_notice_desc: Country names (España, Germany, France) and homonym names (Rosa, Sol, Will, May) are strictly protected and never auto-ignored, as they are crucial vocabulary to learn.
